title: Multiplexer Module - Band 20 (800 MHz) for Millimeter-Wave Beamforming
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Takeshi Yamamoto

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Multiplexer Module filter targeting Band 20 (800 MHz) for Millimeter-Wave Beamforming. The filter is designed on PZT on Si substrate with a target center frequency of 2188.7 MHz and bandwidth of 297.0 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Millimeter-Wave Beamforming module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Multiplexer Module
- Frequency Band: Band 20 (800 MHz)
- Application: Millimeter-Wave Beamforming
- Substrate: PZT on Si
- Package: Flip-Chip BGA
- Design Tool: Synopsys CustomSim
- Design Center: Osaka Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the Multiplexer Module design targeting Band 20 (800 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       2188.7 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       297.0 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.9 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 14.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 30.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 18.0 dB
Q Factor:               6327
Temperature Coefficient:-17.3 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.8 x 0.6 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   12
Electrode Material:     Al
Passivation:            SiO2
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Synopsys CustomSim and load the Multiplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: PZT on Si with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 2188.7 MHz, BW 297.0 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.9 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (Flip-Chip BGA).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, PZT on Si).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Rohde & Schwarz ZNB40.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 6566 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.9 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 14.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 446 MHz offset >= 30.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 7 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 4.7 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +35 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 1000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 85%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-02-07
Devices Tested:         27
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.65 dB
Return Loss (meas):     16.4 dB
Rejection (meas):       33.3 dB
Isolation (meas):       23.3 dB
Q Factor (meas):        6327
Group Delay Variation:  7.2 ns
Power Handling:         +32 dBm
Die Yield:              87.3%

Result Classification:  FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Multiplexer Module design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 20 (800 MHz).
b) Insertion loss is marginally above target; electrode thickness optimization recommended.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Temperature stability was within specification across full range.
e) Cross-talk between adjacent filter channels was below -55 dB.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Optimize resonator geometry to reduce insertion loss by ~0.3 dB.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Escalate to advanced materials team for alternative piezoelectric stack.
